pool.sol: Separable: \( \dfrac{dy}{y}=3\,dx \Rightarrow \ln|y|=3x+C \Rightarrow y=Ae^{3x} \). \( y(0)=A=2 \), so \( y=2e^{3x} \), and \( y(1)=2e^{3} \).
Separable (trivially): \( dy=2x\,dx \Rightarrow y=x^2+C \). \( y(0)=C=5 \), so \( y=x^2+5 \), and \( y(2)=4+5=9 \).

pool.text: A quantity satisfies \( \dfrac{dy}{dt}=-4y \), \( y(0)=10 \). Find the time \( t \) at which \( y=5 \) (the half-life).
pool.sol: Separable: \( \dfrac{dy}{y}=-4\,dt \Rightarrow \ln y=-4t+C \Rightarrow y=10e^{-4t} \). Setting \( 10e^{-4t}=5 \) gives \( e^{-4t}=\tfrac12 \), so \( -4t=-\ln2 \) and \( t=\dfrac{\ln2}{4} \).
Separable: \( \dfrac{dy}{y}=x\,dx \Rightarrow \ln y=\dfrac{x^2}{2}+C \Rightarrow y=Ae^{x^2/2} \). \( y(0)=A=3 \), so \( y=3e^{x^2/2} \), and \( y(2)=3e^{4/2}=3e^{2} \).

pool.text: Solve \( \dfrac{dy}{dx}=\dfrac{x}{y} \) with \( y(0)=4 \) and \( y>0 \). Find \( y(3) \).
pool.sol: Separable: \( y\,dy=x\,dx \Rightarrow \dfrac{y^2}{2}=\dfrac{x^2}{2}+C \Rightarrow y^2=x^2+C' \). \( y(0)^2=16=C' \), so \( y^2=x^2+16 \), and \( y(3)=\sqrt{9+16}=\sqrt{25}=5 \).

Separable: \( \dfrac{dy}{y^2}=x\,dx \Rightarrow -\dfrac{1}{y}=\dfrac{x^2}{2}+C \). At \( x=1,y=-1 \): \( 1=\tfrac12+C \Rightarrow C=\tfrac12 \). So \( -\dfrac1y=\dfrac{x^2+1}{2} \Rightarrow y=-\dfrac{2}{x^2+1} \), and \( y(2)=-\dfrac{2}{5} \).

Separable: \( \dfrac{dy}{1+y^2}=x\,dx \Rightarrow \arctan y=\dfrac{x^2}{2}+C \). \( y(0)=1 \) gives \( \arctan1=\tfrac{\pi}{4}=C \). So \( \arctan y=\dfrac{x^2}{2}+\dfrac{\pi}{4} \), and \( y(1)=\tan\!\big(\tfrac12+\tfrac{\pi}{4}\big) \) (valid since \( \tfrac12+\tfrac{\pi}{4}<\tfrac{\pi}{2} \), i.e. \( x=1 \) is within this solution's domain \( |x|<\sqrt{\pi/2} \)).
Separable: \( \dfrac{dy}{y}=\cos x\,dx \Rightarrow \ln y=\sin x+C \Rightarrow y=Ae^{\sin x} \). \( y(0)=A=2 \), so \( y=2e^{\sin x} \), and \( y(\pi/2)=2e^{\sin(\pi/2)}=2e^{1}=2e \).

pool.text: Newton's law of cooling gives \( \dfrac{dT}{dt}=-k(T-20) \). If \( T(0)=100 \) and \( T(5)=60 \), find \( T(10) \).

pool.sol: Integrating factor \( \mu=e^{x} \): \( (e^{x}y)'=e^{x} \Rightarrow e^{x}y=e^{x}+C \Rightarrow y=1+Ce^{-x} \). \( y(0)=1+C=0 \Rightarrow C=-1 \). So \( y=1-e^{-x} \), and \( y(1)=1-e^{-1} \).

pool.text: Solve \( \dfrac{dy}{dx}+\dfrac{2y}{x}=4 \) for \( x>0 \), \( y(1)=1 \). Find \( y(2) \).
pool.sol: \( \mu=x^2 \): \( (x^2y)'=4x^2 \Rightarrow x^2y=\dfrac{4}{3}x^3+C \Rightarrow y=\dfrac{4x}{3}+\dfrac{C}{x^2} \). \( y(1)=\dfrac43+C=1\Rightarrow C=-\dfrac13 \). So \( y=\dfrac{4x}{3}-\dfrac{1}{3x^2} \), and \( y(2)=\dfrac{8}{3}-\dfrac{1}{12}=\dfrac{31}{12} \).

pool.text: Solve \( \dfrac{dy}{dx}+\dfrac{y}{x}=x \) for \( x>0 \), \( y(1)=0 \). Find \( y(2) \).
pool.sol: \( \mu=x \): \( (xy)'=x^2 \Rightarrow xy=\dfrac{x^3}{3}+C \Rightarrow y=\dfrac{x^2}{3}+\dfrac{C}{x} \). \( y(1)=\dfrac13+C=0\Rightarrow C=-\dfrac13 \). So \( y=\dfrac{x^3-1}{3x} \), and \( y(2)=\dfrac{7}{6} \).

\( \mu=e^{x} \): \( (e^{x}y)'=e^{2x} \Rightarrow e^{x}y=\dfrac{e^{2x}}{2}+C \Rightarrow y=\dfrac{e^{x}}{2}+Ce^{-x} \). \( y(0)=\dfrac12+C=1\Rightarrow C=\dfrac12 \). So \( y=\dfrac{e^{x}+e^{-x}}{2} \), and \( y(1)=\dfrac{e+e^{-1}}{2} \).

\( \mu=e^{x^2} \): \( (e^{x^2}y)'=xe^{x^2} \Rightarrow e^{x^2}y=\dfrac12 e^{x^2}+C \Rightarrow y=\dfrac12+Ce^{-x^2} \). \( y(0)=\dfrac12+C=0\Rightarrow C=-\dfrac12 \). So \( y=\dfrac{1-e^{-x^2}}{2} \), and \( y(1)=\dfrac{1-e^{-1}}{2} \).

pool.text: Solve \( \dfrac{dy}{dx}+\dfrac{3y}{x}=\dfrac{1}{x^2} \) for \( x>0 \), \( y(1)=1 \). Find \( y(2) \).
pool.sol: \( \mu=x^3 \): \( (x^3y)'=x \Rightarrow x^3y=\dfrac{x^2}{2}+C \Rightarrow y=\dfrac{1}{2x}+\dfrac{C}{x^3} \). \( y(1)=\dfrac12+C=1\Rightarrow C=\dfrac12 \). So \( y=\dfrac{x^2+1}{2x^3} \), and \( y(2)=\dfrac{5}{16} \).

pool.text: A tank's volume grows as \( V(t)=50+t \) (liters). The dissolved salt satisfies \( \dfrac{dy}{dt}+\dfrac{y}{50+t}=4 \), \( y(0)=0 \). Find \( y(50) \) (kilograms).
